summary.text: Bay Pavilion is Yi clan's Immortal Gu House. It specializes in long-range chase and space travel across tens of thousands of li.

claims.text: Fang Yuan names one of Yi clan’s Immortal Gu Houses as Bay Pavilion when it appears in Southern Border. The pavilion is not tall, with only two stories and a flat form, ocean blue tiles, a hawk-spreading-wings outline, golden islands on white walls, and blue waves painted on the exposed columns. Its strongest listed ability is long-distance crossing, shooting through over seventy thousand li directly, and Yi clan mobilizes it for long-range chase during the Southern Border super Gu formation crisis with Shadow Sect and Heavenly Court.

After several space warps it catches Fang Yuan’s group and blocks their path; the upper extreme heavenly eagle knocks the pavilion back without damaging it. Bay Pavilion spreads light blue radiance into a blue world and forms storey building water elephants as a defensive method. Fang Yuan identifies the immortal killer move water life resurrection, which creates water lifeforms for battle so that destroyed beasts cost little if the blue light returns, and Wu clan analysis ties the move to transformation path, water path, and light path Immortal Gu.
Deviation (recorded): this page is filed under gu-houses because Bay Pavilion is a named Immortal Gu House. It is mobile Yi clan equipment, not a five-region map seat.

Bay Pavilion is a rank seven Immortal Gu House; even Heaven Overseeing Tower was corroded when it fell into a dream realm. When Bay Pavilion is trapped in dream realms, the pavilion begins to break apart and Yi clan Gu Immortals lose control of many Gu worms. They activate its strongest method, immortal killer move Boundless Sea and Sky; dazzling blue light fails to pierce the dream realms, then Bay Pavilion disappears and reappears in ruins. Before that clash, Yi clan with the house was judged slightly stronger than Fang Yuan’s side for a short fight, able to attack, defend, advance, or retreat freely. They had also activated water life resurrection for a prolonged battle before Fang Yuan sent Pure Dream Reality Seeker bodies at the pavilion. Yi clan leaders later say Immortal Gu were undamaged and spare mortal Gu can restore Bay Pavilion within minutes.

Fairy Zi Wei tells Heavenly Court that Yi clan’s Immortal Gu House Bay Pavilion unexpectedly met Fang Yuan’s group and could not stop him. She adds that Fang Yuan inspected himself after guessing he was tracked and found something fishy.
Fang Yuan’s group had already run into Yi clan’s Immortal Gu House Bay Pavilion while on the run. When the same move appears again, Yi clan Gu Immortals retreat far away with Bay Pavilion.
